rules.EMA: EMA20 alpha=2/21; EMA50 alpha=2/51; first-close seed, adjust=False; subsequent EMA=alpha*close+(1-alpha)*previousEMA
rules.SMA200: arithmetic average of 200 closes including current completed close; first entry eligible at index199
rules.entry: current EMA20>EMA50 AND prior EMA20<=prior EMA50 AND current close>SMA200; daily crossover EVENT, not merely bullish EMA state
rules.exit: current EMA20<EMA50 AND prior EMA20>=prior EMA50; no price/SMA exit condition added
rules.execution: completed daily close signals, next available symbol session open fills; one long per symbol; entry only if flat, exit only if held
rules.initialization: EMAs start equal at first close; no initial-state entry; full200bar entry warmup; calculations retain prior EMA state
rules.terminal: no forced liquidation; open positions separately marked; final-bar entry/exit signals pending and unfilled
rules.portfolio_DD: unavailable: no sizing/capital constraints/mark-to-market portfolio model
rules.coverage: same 692 current exact-universe Turso stocks, 52 missing and seven stale excluded; no aliases substituted or new Fyers requests
limitations: fixed present-day mirrored universe has survivorship bias
missing sessions may distort indicators; first-close EMA seeding influences early values
zero costs and unconstrained concurrent capital limit practical comparability

issues.reason: unverified extreme or invalid-price historical trade

caveats: Historical closed-trade arithmetic statistics, not portfolio returns. Open trades excluded. No equal-capital sizing, compounding, equity curve, CAGR, or portfolio drawdown.
Gross zero costs; present-day universe survivorship bias; mixed-source corporate-action adjustments and missing sessions remain unverified. Extreme returns are data-sensitive, not recommendations.
